tools.name: google_drive_list
tools.description: List the user's most recently modified, non-trashed Google Drive files. This is read-only and returns a limited page. `max_results` and the number of returned rows are never exact match counts when `hasMore` is true. Never count those rows or present them as exact bulk-action totals. Results include file name, type, size (in bytes), modified date, owners, and web link.

max_results.description: Maximum number of files to return. Defaults to 5.

query.description: Optional Google Drive full-text search query.

order_by.description: Optional compatibility hint. Results are always ordered by modified time descending, regardless of this value.

tools.name: google_drive_create_folder
tools.description: Create a new folder in Google Drive.

name.description: The name of the new folder.

parent_id.description: Optional parent folder ID where the new folder should be created.

tools.name: google_drive_upload
tools.description: Upload a local file from the host computer to Google Drive.

local_path.description: Absolute path of the local file on the host machine.

name.description: Optional custom name for the uploaded file in Google Drive. Defaults to the base name of the local file.

parent_id.description: Optional target folder ID in Google Drive where the file should be uploaded.

tools.name: google_drive_delete
tools.description: Move a Google Drive file or folder to the trash.

file_id.description: The ID of the file or folder to move to trash.
